changes.new: Home solicitation sales as West Virginia defines them: a consumer credit sale over $25 solicited away from the seller's business (a cash job is under the federal rule only), on top of the federal rule
changes.support: So West Virginia's article reaches CREDIT sales (and sales paid by a consumer loan where the creditor is subject to claims and defenses); a cash job is under the federal rule only.

changes.new: Attorney General rule expects a written contract from $250 (142 CSR 5-3.3); written contract required for licensees at $10,000 or more (30-42-10)
changes.support: So the Attorney General rule expects a written contract from $250, well below the $10,000 licensing-statute floor.
So the Attorney General rule expects a written contract from $250, well below the $10,000 licensing-statute floor.

changes.new: License at $5,000 or more residential (30-42-3, 30-42-6); painting and landscaping are outside the definition of contractor (30-42-3); old 21-11 repealed
changes.support: Painting and landscaping: the exemption is in the definition, not in 30-42-6.

changes.new: No cap found; a clause requiring liquidated damages or forfeiture of a deposit on cancellation is prohibited (142 CSR 5-3.1.28)
changes.support: a clause requiring liquidated damages or the forfeiture of any deposit or any other amount already paid upon cancellation of the home improvement contract
